variants.name: 20 Round Magazine
variants.info:
A larger 20 round magazine!
Doubles your magazine capacity at the cost of handling, mobility and reload time!

variants.name: XM1158 AAP
variants.info:
The XM1158 Advanced Armor Piercing Round is an armor piercing round replacing both the M80A1 and M993 rounds in 2020.
Significantly increases penetration and comes with a 20 round magazine at the cost of lower damage up close and to the torso!
Has typical extended magazine downsides!

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Silent
variants.info:
Experimental XM115 made for 7.62x51mm NATO firearms.

Similar functions to a flash hider, reduces sound too.

Bullet speed and suppression reduced. Works great with suppressors!
